evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and implements new `setprunelock` and `listprunelocks` commands in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
rationale: Adds new RPC endpoints allowing external software and users to manage prune locks, preventing blocks needed for wallet rescans from being pruned. Reviewers note this enables external wallets to reliably build on top of a pruned node via RPC, though it is reasonably deferrable.
